# Cncf Kyma Reviewer

Review Kyma using its official documentation and repository in the Platform / PaaS/Container Service category. Kyma is the opinionated set of Kubernetes based modular building blocks that includes the necessary capabilities to develop and run enterprise-grade cloud-native applications.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
